channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Budget Session 2026: President Droupadi Murmu maps India's growth journey, terrorism, talks about OP Sindoor
item.description: President Droupadi Murmu delivered the customary address to a joint sitting of the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha on Tuesday, formally inaugurating the Budget Session of Parliament for 2026. Her speech set the stage for legislative business, including debates on national policies, social welfare, and the forthcoming Union Budget.

item.title: How User Habits Create Security Gaps in Digital Payments
item.description: When safety becomes as instinctive as the payment itself, the gaps in our digital defenses will finally begin to close.

item.title: Indian doctors keep prescribing pills for diet problems: Dr Rajeena Shahin [Exclusive]
item.description: As lifestyle diseases surge across younger Indians, PAN India's Medical Director explains why nutrition remains sidelined in medical education and why food-led, plant-forward interventions are key to prevention and reversal.

item.title: Ajit Pawar death: Sharad Pawar cries, says, 'don't bring politics into it, it was an accident' [Watch]
item.description: Sharad Pawar has issued his first public statement after the death of his nephew Ajit Pawar on Tuesday. Amid allegations of foul play, Sharad Pawar said Ajit Pawar death was purely an accident, and there is no need to politicise the issue.

item.title: How AI Platforms Are Driving Multimillion-Dollar Growth in Financial Services
item.description: The emergence of large language models and generative AI systems after 2022 created opportunities for enterprise technology leaders to develop next-generation financial platforms

item.title: Sensex, Nifty trade lower weighed down by IT stocks
item.description: As of 9.30 am, Sensex eased 347 points, or 0.42 per cent, to reach 81,997, and Nifty lost 81 points, or 0.32 per cent at 25,260.

item.title: FM Sitharaman set to present Economic Survey 2026, all eyes on GDP growth estimates
item.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman will present the Economic Survey. All eyes will be on India's projected GDP growth estimates for the current fiscal (FY26) as well as the upcoming financial year (FY27).

item.title: India, EU conclude negotiations on financial services to boost digital payments, fintech
item.description: Among the key achievements of Financial Services Annex, India and EU have committed to collaborate on enabling greater interoperability and interlinkages and development of electronic payment infrastructure and convenience of cross-border payments to promote real-time cross border remittances, merchant payments and other transfers.

item.title: Delhi HC refuses to entertain Sameer Wankhede's defamation plea against Netflix, SRK's company
item.description: The Delhi High Court has declined to hear IRS officer Sameer Wankhede's defamation suit against Shah Rukh Khan's production house Red Chillies Entertainment and Netflix over his alleged portrayal in the web series The Ba**ds of Bollywood. Justice Purushaindra Kaurav ruled that the court lacked jurisdiction and returned the plea, directing Wankhede to approach the appropriate court.

item.title: Explained: New Aadhaar mobile app enables quick verification, selective data sharing
item.description: The application allows users to present Aadhaar for verification without showing a physical card or submitting photocopies. Further, users can share only the specific details required on a use-case basis and will speed up identity checks at places such as airports, hotels, hospitals and on various service platforms.
